llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must run animation-critical computation in UI-runtime worklets (for example `useDerivedValue`/worklet functions) over shared values.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: computeNextCheckpoint is a plain worklet function called imperatively inside animationLoop; no useDerivedValue or equivalent UI-runtime reactive derived value is used for animation-critical computation.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must dispatch start/stop or control worklet functions from React runtime using `scheduleOnUI(...)` from `react-native-worklets` and MUST NOT use deprecated `runOnUI`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: startAnimation dispatches to the UI thread via runOnUI (deprecated per criteria), not scheduleOnUI from react-native-worklets. The package.json has no react-native-worklets dependency.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must bridge UI-runtime checkpoint updates back to React via `scheduleOnRN(...)` from `react-native-worklets` and MUST NOT use deprecated `runOnJS`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: React runtime is updated via runOnJS(setCheckpoint) (deprecated per criteria); scheduleOnRN from react-native-worklets is never used.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must gate `scheduleOnRN(...)` behind explicit bucket/checkpoint logic in a UI worklet reaction (for example `useAnimatedReaction`) instead of calling it every frame.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: updateCheckpoint (which calls runOnJS) is invoked directly inside animationLoop on every step transition with no useAnimatedReaction wrapper or bucket/threshold guard deferring React updates.
